# twigg

twigg is a package developed for the procedure of testing within item set 
grouping and graphical models. It consits of a collection of tests for 
item consistency, differential item functioning, local dependence, score-covariate
association and graph checking.

## Installation

Package installation can be done directly by calling
'devtools::install_github("SebastianKvist99/twigg")'
